package rulefixtures

import "github.com/jmoiron/sqlx"

// scenario for go_perf_layer_framework_performance_sqlx_select_slice_unbounded: Layer: Framework-specific performance. Flag sqlx Select into slices without LIMIT or streaming for large tables.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.

type Record struct {
	ID   int    `db:"id"`
	Data string `db:"data"`
}

func FetchAllRecords(db *sqlx.DB) ([]Record, error) {
	var items []Record
	err := db.Select(&items, "SELECT id, data FROM large_table")
	return items, err
}

func FetchAllLogs(db *sqlx.DB) ([]Record, error) {
	var items []Record
	err := db.Select(&items, "SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'")
	return items, err
}
